root_cause: _resume_review_qa_candidate only whitelisted a small set of automated_remediation hold reasons for QA-only retries. Structured review/QA gate failures such as structured_review_blocking_findings and structured_qa_verdict_not_pass were persisted in loop memory but never mapped to a resume candidate, so the scheduler could not continue code remediation on the existing branch.
symptom: 自维护循环在结构化审查/QA门禁 hold_for_automated_remediation 后停滞：open_items 累积 reason=structured_review_blocking_findings 或 structured_qa_verdict_not_pass，但下一轮 _resume_review_qa_candidate 返回 None，无法在原分支上继续 code→review→qa 修复。
